description.value: Onigiri Ya is a Japanese rice ball shop on West Broadway, operated by the Maruhachi Ramen Group, specializing in freshly made onigiri for pickup. It is a compact, takeout-only operation with an online pre-order system — ideal for a quick, portable meal on the go. The Broadway location is one of three Vancouver outposts from this local group.
